report_summary: This report is notably careful about identities, static payloads, cookie-reading versus exfiltration, and cumulative snapshot amplification. It records concurrent deletion and later rewriting, but incorrectly explains archive structure by saying deleted page summaries disappear and infers reduced live reachability from deletion membership alone.
